rawFindings.title: Public add API was removed
rawFindings.explanation: This change renames the exported `AdminNavigation.add` implementation to `addToSite` and removes the `addToSite` wrapper, leaving no `AdminNavigation.add` method. Existing callers of the previously exported API now fail before any node can be added.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore a backward-compatible wrapper, e.g. define `AdminNavigation.add = function(node, site) { return AdminNavigation.addToSite(node, site); };` after `addToSite`.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Calling `pb.AdminNavigation.add({id: 'custom_nav'})` now throws `TypeError: pb.AdminNavigation.add is not a function` instead of adding the global navigation node.

rawFindings.title: removeFromSite no longer defaults to the global site
rawFindings.explanation: The default-site handling that was in `AdminNavigation.remove` was removed when the implementation was moved into `removeFromSite`. Calling `removeFromSite` without a site can find the global node via `buildNavigation(undefined)`, then attempts to remove it from `AdminNavigation.additions[undefined]`, causing a crash.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the null/undefined site check at the start of `removeFromSite` and set `site = GLOBAL_SITE` before building/removing navigation.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: After `pb.AdminNavigation.addToSite({id: 'custom_nav'})`, calling `pb.AdminNavigation.removeFromSite('custom_nav')` throws when `removeNode` receives `AdminNavigation.additions[undefined]` instead of removing the global node.

rawFindings.title: Public remove API was removed
rawFindings.explanation: This change renames the exported `AdminNavigation.remove` implementation to `removeFromSite` and removes the `removeFromSite` wrapper, leaving no `AdminNavigation.remove` method. Existing callers of the previously exported removal API now fail immediately.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore a backward-compatible wrapper, e.g. `AdminNavigation.remove = function(id, site) { return AdminNavigation.removeFromSite(id, site); };`.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Calling `pb.AdminNavigation.remove('custom_nav')` now throws `TypeError: pb.AdminNavigation.remove is not a function` instead of removing the node.
